column1: # E1M pads that terminate on the on-module TI CC3501E Wi-Fi 6 + BLE 5.4
# combo MCU rather than on the Alif Ensemble SoC.  Apps reach these pads
# through the CC3501E host-control surface (Alif drives SPI1 to the WiFi
# MCU; see inter-chip.tsv), not through Alif GPIO peripherals.  Tracks
# NOT customer IO: IO16 and IO17 land on the two CC3501E pads the bridge
# firmware owns and actively refuses.  cc3501e-bridge-firmware
# from the GPIO proxy: GPIO_16 is the inter-chip SPI0 chip-select paired
# with the Alif hardware SPI1_SS0_C, and GPIO_17 is the READY line that
# gates every reply phase and carries the async-event attention edge.
# Driving either would tear the link down mid-transfer, which is exactly
# what the reservation prevents.  They are named here so the pinout stays
# complete, with the claim recorded in the peripheral column (#1808).
